intro: Maxan Anvol is a dwarven priest trainer stationed within the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Dedicated to the Holy Light, he guides fledgling dwarven priests as they learn to channel divine power amid Dun Morogh's frigid climes. He tests young acolytes to ensure they are worthy of wearing the vestments of the church.

p: While it might seem strange to find an ordained minister of the Holy Light stationed inside Thunderbrew Distillery, it suits dwarven culture well. Kharanos serves as the primary hub between Coldridge Valley and Ironforge, and the local inn is where travelers, mountaineers, and acolytes naturally gather. Maxan tends to the spiritual welfare of the hamlet alongside pints of stout, offering prayers and counsel to any who step through the doors.

Maxan Anvol is responsible for vetting novice priests before they venture into the wider world. He tasks initiates with demonstrating mastery over fundamental curative prayers on wounded defenders of Dun Morogh. Those who prove their devotion and practical competence are bestowed their first proper priestly vestments, formally marking their recognized standing within the Church of the Holy Light.
